assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one reusable painted UI panel frame for the original game Lantern Cat Café. Create a single square ornate gold-bevel rectangular frame, front-facing and perfectly symmetric, with compact curled leaf-and-paw details in all four corners. Broad straight edge stretches suitable for a nine-slice UI border; frame stays within the outer 12% on each edge, leaving the central 76% empty and genuinely transparent. Hand-painted chunky fantasy game finish, warm honey gold highlights from upper left, deep plum edge shadows, subtle worn bronze texture, small teal enamel insets at corner centers. Entire outside and center transparent; no background, no labels, no lettering, no UI content, no watermark. Original design from this text alone, no reference images. Square 1024px asset, keep all edges fully inside canvas with a narrow transparent safety margin.
